mapper.select: SELECT pct.id, pct.module_id, pct.data_name, pct.phone, pct.create_time, pct.scope_user_id, pcu.data_name AS customer_name FROM crm_pre_contacts pct LEFT JOIN crm_pre_customer pcu ON pcu.id = pct.customer_id WHERE pct.data_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{checkDTO.checkValue}, '%') ORDER BY pct.update_time DESC LIMIT 10;
